```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(Seurat)
library(igraph)
library(Matrix)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dendsort)
library(reticulate)


theme_set(theme_cowplot(font_size = 11))

OUTPUT_DIR   <- file.path("output", "objects")
SCENIC_DIR   <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "scenic")
CELLRANK_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "cellrank", "cytotrace")
```

# Overview

Six cluster × cluster similarity / distance / transition matrices for HSC,
computed for the full cohort and each condition (WT, mCh−, mCh+).
Each heatmap is clustered independently (Ward.D2 on Euclidean distance of rows).

| Matrix | Type | Interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| Variable gene expression | Similarity (Pearson r) | Transcriptional relatedness |
| SCENIC TF regulon activity | Similarity (Pearson r) | Regulatory state relatedness |
| CellRank fate probability | Similarity (Pearson r) | Shared differentiation fate |
| CellRank cluster transition | Probability (row-stochastic) | One-step Markov transition flux |
| SNN connectivity (PAGA) | Connectivity (normalised) | Physical graph adjacency |
| PCA centroid distance | Distance (Euclidean) | Low-dim transcriptional distance |
| Graph shortest-path distance | Distance (hops) | Topological separation |

---

# 1  Load data & compute full-cohort matrices

```{r load}
mpn_full <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

# Try annotation target; fall back to the base cluster column
anno <- tryCatch(targets::tar_read(annotation_recluster_hsc), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(anno)) {
  mpn_full <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_full, anno)
  clus_col <- grep("0.9", colnames(mpn_full@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
} else {
  clus_col <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.9$", colnames(mpn_full@meta.data),
                   value = TRUE)[1]
}

clus     <- as.factor(mpn_full@meta.data[[clus_col]])
clusters <- levels(clus)
n_cl     <- length(clusters)

# Named vector used to transfer labels to condition objects
clus_all <- setNames(as.character(clus), colnames(mpn_full))

# Full-cohort SNN (kept for PAGA computation)
snn_name <- grep("sNN", names(mpn_full@graphs), value = TRUE)[1]
snn      <- mpn_full@graphs[[snn_name]]
n_cells  <- ncol(mpn_full)

# ── SCENIC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
auc_path <- file.path(SCENIC_DIR, "auc_mtx_raw_full.csv")   # all cells (scripts/slurm/analysis/scenic.sh)
auc_raw  <- NULL
if (file.exists(auc_path)) {
  auc_raw <- readr::read_csv(auc_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames(
      colnames(readr::read_csv(auc_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))[1])
  cat("SCENIC: loaded", nrow(auc_raw), "cells ×", ncol(auc_raw), "regulons\n")
}

# ── CellRank ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Per-cell fate probabilities (for per-condition Pearson-r similarity)
fate_path <- file.path(CELLRANK_DIR, "tables", "fate_probabilities.csv")
fate_raw  <- NULL
if (file.exists(fate_path)) {
  fate_raw <- readr::read_csv(fate_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames(
      colnames(readr::read_csv(fate_path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))[1]) |>
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9", "sample.name",
                                    "dm2_class", "condition")))
  cat("CellRank: loaded", nrow(fate_raw), "cells ×", ncol(fate_raw), "states\n")
}

# Direct cluster × cluster transition matrix (Markov step probabilities)
cl_trans_path <- file.path(CELLRANK_DIR, "tables", "cluster_transition_matrix.csv")
mat_cl_trans  <- NULL
if (file.exists(cl_trans_path)) {
  mat_cl_trans_raw <- readr::read_csv(cl_trans_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")
  # Align to common clusters (cluster labels are character; strip any whitespace)
  common_cl <- intersect(clusters, colnames(mat_cl_trans_raw))
  mat_cl_trans <- as.matrix(mat_cl_trans_raw[common_cl, common_cl])
  cat("CellRank cluster transition matrix:", nrow(mat_cl_trans),
      "×", ncol(mat_cl_trans), "clusters\n")
}

cat("Full cohort | Clusters:", n_cl, "| Cells:", n_cells, "\n")

# ── hdWGCNA metacells — build igraph + cluster/condition metadata ───────────────
targets::tar_load(hdwgcna_hsc_modules)
mc_obj_tmp <- hdWGCNA::GetMetacellObject(hdwgcna_hsc_modules, wgcna_name = "hsc_modules")
rm(hdwgcna_hsc_modules); invisible(gc())

mc_cells_split <- stringr::str_split(mc_obj_tmp$cells_merged, ",")
names(mc_cells_split) <- colnames(mc_obj_tmp)

# Majority cluster per metacell (from full-cohort clus_all)
mc_clus <- vapply(mc_cells_split, function(cells) {
  v <- clus_all[intersect(cells, names(clus_all))]
  if (!length(v)) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(v), decreasing = TRUE))[1L]
}, character(1L))

# Majority condition per metacell
cond_all <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("WT",     mpn_full$sample.name) ~ "WT",
  grepl("mCh-",   mpn_full$sample.name) ~ "mCh-",
  grepl("mCh\\+", mpn_full$sample.name) ~ "mCh+",
  TRUE ~ mpn_full$sample.name
) |> setNames(colnames(mpn_full))

mc_cond <- vapply(mc_cells_split, function(cells) {
  v <- cond_all[intersect(cells, names(cond_all))]
  if (!length(v)) return(NA_character_)
  names(sort(table(v), decreasing = TRUE))[1L]
}, character(1L))

# Median PCA coordinates per metacell (from full-cohort PCA)
pca_all    <- mpn_full@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings
mc_pca_med <- do.call(rbind, lapply(mc_cells_split, function(cells) {
  ok <- intersect(cells, rownames(pca_all))
  if (!length(ok)) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(pca_all)))
  colMeans(pca_all[ok, , drop = FALSE])
}))
rownames(mc_pca_med) <- colnames(mc_obj_tmp)

# Build k-NN graph from median PCA coordinates of metacells
mc_pca_ok  <- mc_pca_med[complete.cases(mc_pca_med), , drop = FALSE]
nn_res     <- Seurat::FindNeighbors(mc_pca_ok, verbose = FALSE)
mc_snn     <- nn_res$snn                               # dgCMatrix (metacell × metacell)
g_mc       <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(
  as(mc_snn, "CsparseMatrix"), weighted = TRUE, mode = "undirected", diag = FALSE)
igraph::E(g_mc)$inv_weight <- 1 / (igraph::E(g_mc)$weight + 1e-6)

# All-pairs shortest paths on full metacell graph (tractable: hundreds of nodes)
cat("Metacell graph:", igraph::vcount(g_mc), "nodes,",
    igraph::ecount(g_mc), "edges — computing all-pairs shortest paths ...\n")
all_mc_dists <- igraph::distances(g_mc, weights = igraph::E(g_mc)$inv_weight)
cat("Done.\n")

rm(mc_obj_tmp, mc_cells_split, mc_snn, mc_pca_ok, mc_pca_med,
   nn_res, pca_all, cond_all, g_mc)
invisible(gc())

# ── Helper: cluster × cluster mean shortest-path via metacells ─────────────────
# all_mc_dists: metacell × metacell distance matrix (pre-computed Dijkstra)
# mc_clus_filt: named character (metacell → cluster), filtered to desired condition
graph_mc_dist <- function(clusters_use, all_mc_dists, mc_clus_filt) {
  vnames <- rownames(all_mc_dists)
  cl_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, length(clusters_use), length(clusters_use),
                   dimnames = list(clusters_use, clusters_use))
  for (i in clusters_use) {
    mc_i <- intersect(names(mc_clus_filt)[mc_clus_filt == i], vnames)
    for (j in clusters_use) {
      mc_j <- intersect(names(mc_clus_filt)[mc_clus_filt == j], vnames)
      if (!length(mc_i) || !length(mc_j)) next
      cl_mat[i, j] <- mean(all_mc_dists[mc_i, mc_j, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  cl_mat
}
```

```{r mat-full}
# ── 1. Expression ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
hvg <- Seurat::VariableFeatures(mpn_full)
expr_mat <- Seurat::AverageExpression(
  mpn_full, features = hvg, assays = "SCT", layer = "data",
  group.by = clus_col, return.seurat = FALSE)$SCT
expr_mat@Dimnames[[2]] <- str_remove(expr_mat@Dimnames[[2]], "g")
mat_expr_full <- cor(as.matrix(expr_mat), method = "pearson")[clusters, clusters]

# ── 2. SCENIC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_scenic_full <- NULL
if (!is.null(auc_raw)) {
  common_cells <- intersect(rownames(auc_raw), colnames(mpn_full))
  auc_aligned  <- as.matrix(auc_raw[common_cells, ])
  cl_aligned   <- as.character(clus)[match(common_cells, colnames(mpn_full))]
  auc_avg <- do.call(cbind, lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
    colMeans(auc_aligned[cl_aligned == cl, , drop = FALSE])
  }))
  colnames(auc_avg) <- clusters
  mat_scenic_full <- cor(auc_avg, method = "pearson")
}

# ── 3. CellRank ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_cellrank_full <- NULL
if (!is.null(fate_raw)) {
  common_cells <- intersect(rownames(fate_raw), colnames(mpn_full))
  fate_aligned <- as.matrix(fate_raw[common_cells, ])
  cl_fate      <- as.character(clus)[match(common_cells, colnames(mpn_full))]
  fate_avg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
    colMeans(fate_aligned[cl_fate == cl, , drop = FALSE])
  }))
  rownames(fate_avg) <- clusters
  mat_cellrank_full <- cor(t(fate_avg), method = "pearson")
}

# ── 4. PAGA ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
paga_mat <- matrix(0, n_cl, n_cl, dimnames = list(clusters, clusters))
for (i in clusters) {
  for (j in clusters) {
    ci <- which(clus == i); cj <- which(clus == j)
    paga_mat[i, j] <- sum(snn[ci, cj]) / ((length(ci) * length(cj)) / n_cells + 1e-6)
  }
}
mat_paga_full <- paga_mat

# ── 5. PCA centroid distance ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_emb <- as.data.frame(mpn_full@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings)
pca_emb$cluster <- as.character(clus)
pca_centroids <- pca_emb |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(starts_with("PC_"), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")
mat_pca_full <- as.matrix(dist(pca_centroids[clusters, ], method = "euclidean"))

# ── 6. Graph shortest-path (mean metacell Dijkstra distance per cluster pair) ──
mat_graph_full <- graph_mc_dist(clusters, all_mc_dists, mc_clus)

rm(mpn_full, pca_emb, pca_centroids, paga_mat, expr_mat); invisible(gc())
cat("Full-cohort matrices computed.\n")
```

# 2  Per-condition matrices

```{r cond-fn}
#' Compute all six transition matrices for a condition-specific Seurat object.
#'
#' @param srt         Loaded Seurat object.
#' @param clus_all    Named character vector: cell_id → cluster label.
#' @param clus_col    Name of the metadata column to add.
#' @param cond_label    One of "WT", "mCh-", "mCh+" — used to filter metacells.
#' @param mc_clus       Named character (metacell → cluster), full cohort.
#' @param mc_cond       Named character (metacell → condition), full cohort.
#' @param all_mc_dists  Pre-computed all-pairs shortest-path matrix on metacell graph.
#' @param auc_raw       SCENIC AUC data.frame (or NULL).
#' @param fate_raw      CellRank fate data.frame (or NULL).
compute_matrices <- function(srt, clus_all, clus_col, cond_label,
                              mc_clus, mc_cond, all_mc_dists,
                              auc_raw = NULL, fate_raw = NULL) {
  # Transfer cluster labels from full cohort
  cond_cells <- intersect(colnames(srt), names(clus_all))
  clus_vec   <- clus_all[cond_cells]
  cl         <- sort(unique(clus_vec))
  n          <- length(cond_cells)

  # Add to metadata so AverageExpression can use it
  meta_add <- data.frame(row.names = cond_cells, tmp_ = clus_vec)
  colnames(meta_add) <- clus_col
  srt <- Seurat::AddMetaData(srt, meta_add)

  # 1. Expression
  hvg      <- Seurat::VariableFeatures(srt)
  expr_mat <- Seurat::AverageExpression(
    srt, features = hvg, assays = "SCT", layer = "data",
    group.by = clus_col, return.seurat = FALSE)$SCT
  expr_mat@Dimnames[[2]] <- str_remove(expr_mat@Dimnames[[2]], "g")
  mat_expr <- cor(as.matrix(expr_mat), method = "pearson")[cl, cl]

  # 2. SCENIC
  mat_scenic <- NULL
  if (!is.null(auc_raw)) {
    common <- intersect(rownames(auc_raw), cond_cells)
    if (length(common) > 0) {
      auc_a  <- as.matrix(auc_raw[common, ])
      cl_a   <- clus_vec[common]
      auc_avg <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cl, function(c) {
        colMeans(auc_a[cl_a == c, , drop = FALSE])
      }))
      colnames(auc_avg) <- cl
      mat_scenic <- cor(auc_avg, method = "pearson")
    }
  }

  # 3. CellRank
  mat_cellrank <- NULL
  if (!is.null(fate_raw)) {
    common <- intersect(rownames(fate_raw), cond_cells)
    if (length(common) > 0) {
      fate_a   <- as.matrix(fate_raw[common, ])
      cl_f     <- clus_vec[common]
      fate_avg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cl, function(c) {
        colMeans(fate_a[cl_f == c, , drop = FALSE])
      }))
      rownames(fate_avg) <- cl
      mat_cellrank <- cor(t(fate_avg), method = "pearson")
    }
  }

  # 4. PAGA (condition-specific SNN)
  snn_nm  <- grep("sNN", names(srt@graphs), value = TRUE)[1]
  snn_c   <- srt@graphs[[snn_nm]][cond_cells, cond_cells]
  clus_f  <- factor(clus_vec, levels = cl)
  paga_c  <- matrix(0, length(cl), length(cl), dimnames = list(cl, cl))
  for (i in cl) {
    for (j in cl) {
      ci <- which(clus_f == i); cj <- which(clus_f == j)
      paga_c[i, j] <- sum(snn_c[ci, cj]) /
        ((length(ci) * length(cj)) / n + 1e-6)
    }
  }
  mat_paga <- paga_c

  # 5. PCA centroid distance
  pca_e <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "pca.SCT")[cond_cells, ])
  pca_e$cluster <- clus_vec
  pca_cen <- pca_e |>
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
    dplyr::summarise(dplyr::across(starts_with("PC_"), mean), .groups = "drop") |>
    tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster")
  mat_pca <- as.matrix(dist(pca_cen[cl, ], method = "euclidean"))

  # 6. Graph shortest-path (mean metacell Dijkstra, condition-filtered metacells)
  mc_clus_cond <- mc_clus[!is.na(mc_clus) & mc_clus %in% cl &
                             !is.na(mc_cond) & mc_cond == cond_label]
  mat_graph <- graph_mc_dist(cl, all_mc_dists, mc_clus_cond)

  list(clusters = cl, expr = mat_expr, scenic = mat_scenic,
       cellrank = mat_cellrank, paga = mat_paga, pca = mat_pca, graph = mat_graph)
}
```

```{r cond-wt}
cat("Loading WT ...\n")
srt_wt <- targets::tar_read(mpn_processed_hsc_wt_fullcc)
mats_wt <- compute_matrices(srt_wt, clus_all, clus_col, "WT",
                            mc_clus, mc_cond, all_mc_dists,
                            auc_raw, fate_raw)
rm(srt_wt); invisible(gc())
cat("WT:", length(mats_wt$clusters), "clusters\n")
```

# 3  Shared cluster ordering (full cohort)

```{r cluster-order}
row_dend <- hclust(as.dist(1 - mat_expr_full), method = "ward.D2")
cl_order <- clusters[row_dend$order]
cat("Full-cohort cluster order:", paste(cl_order, collapse = " → "), "\n")
```

# 4  Visualisation helpers

```{r plot-fn}
# cluster_order: character vector of cluster labels defining the fixed row/col order.
# Clusters absent from `mat` are silently dropped; no internal dendrogram is drawn.
# When NULL, Ward.D2 on Euclidean distance is used (full-cohort default path).
plot_heatmap <- function(mat, col_fun, title, legend = "", cluster_order = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(cluster_order)) {
    ord <- cluster_order[cluster_order %in% rownames(mat)]
    mat <- mat[ord, ord]
    cr <- FALSE; cc <- FALSE
    srd <- FALSE; scd <- FALSE
  } else {
    dend <- as.dendrogram(
      dendsort::dendsort(
        hclust(dist(mat, method = "euclidean"), method = "ward.D2")))
    cr <- dend; cc <- dend
    srd <- TRUE; scd <- TRUE
  }

  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    mat,
    col                  = col_fun,
    name                 = legend,
    cluster_rows         = cr,
    cluster_columns      = cc,
    show_row_dend        = srd,
    show_column_dend     = scd,
    row_dend_width       = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    column_dend_height   = unit(1.5, "cm"),
    row_names_side       = "left",
    column_names_rot     = 45,
    row_names_gp         = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_title         = title,
    column_title_gp      = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    rect_gp              = grid::gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      grid::grid.text(round(mat[i, j], 2), x, y,
                      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 5, col = "grey30"))
    },
    heatmap_legend_param = list(title = legend, title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8))
  )
}

# Colour functions
cf_corr <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))

max_paga <- max(
  max(mat_paga_full, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_wt$paga,  na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_neg$paga, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_pos$paga, na.rm = TRUE))
cf_conn <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, max_paga), c("white", "#1b7837"))

max_pca <- max(
  max(mat_pca_full,  na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_wt$pca,   na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_neg$pca,  na.rm = TRUE),
  max(mats_pos$pca,  na.rm = TRUE))
cf_dist_pca <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, max_pca), c("white", "#762a83"))

graph_vals <- c(
  mat_graph_full[lower.tri(mat_graph_full)],
  mats_wt$graph[lower.tri(mats_wt$graph)],
  mats_neg$graph[lower.tri(mats_neg$graph)],
  mats_pos$graph[lower.tri(mats_pos$graph)])
graph_vals <- graph_vals[is.finite(graph_vals)]
cf_dist_graph <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(0, quantile(graph_vals, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)), c("white", "#543005"))
```

               "SCENIC TF regulon activity — mCh−\n(Pearson r)", "r",
               cluster_order = cl_order)
} else cat("SCENIC results not available.\n")

# 7.5  CellRank cluster transition probabilities

One-step Markov transition probabilities between clusters, computed as the
row-normalised mean of the cell-level CytoTRACE2-based transition matrix
(`L @ T @ R`, where L and R are cluster indicator matrices). Rows are source
clusters, columns are target clusters; each row sums to 1. High off-diagonal
values indicate directed probability flux from source → target.

```{r cr-trans, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}
if (!is.null(mat_cl_trans)) {
  cl_ord_filt <- cl_order[cl_order %in% rownames(mat_cl_trans)]
  mat_plot <- mat_cl_trans[cl_ord_filt, cl_ord_filt]
  cf_trans  <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 0.05, 1), c("#f7f7f7", "#fed976", "#b10026"))
  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    mat_plot,
    col                = cf_trans,
    name               = "P(i→j)",
    cluster_rows       = FALSE,
    cluster_columns    = FALSE,
    row_names_side     = "left",
    column_names_rot   = 45,
    row_names_gp       = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_names_gp    = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8),
    column_title       = "CellRank cluster transition (CytoTRACE2)\n(one-step Markov probability)",
    column_title_gp    = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
      v <- mat_plot[i, j]
      if (v > 0.02)
        grid::grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", v), x, y,
                        gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 5,
                                        col = if (v > 0.4) "white" else "black"))
    }
  )
} else cat("CellRank cluster transition matrix not available.\n")
```

# 11  Cross-matrix correlation (full cohort)

Pairwise Spearman correlation of lower-triangle entries for the full-cohort matrices.

```{r mat-corr}
extract_lower <- function(m) m[lower.tri(m)]

reorder_mat <- function(m) { ord <- cl_order[cl_order %in% rownames(m)]; m[ord, ord] }

mat_list <- list(
  Expression = extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_expr_full)),
  PAGA       = extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_paga_full)),
  PCA_dist   = extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_pca_full)),
  Graph_dist = extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_graph_full))
)
if (!is.null(mat_scenic_full))   mat_list$SCENIC        <- extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_scenic_full))
if (!is.null(mat_cellrank_full)) mat_list$CellRank_fate <- extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_cellrank_full))
if (!is.null(mat_cl_trans))      mat_list$CellRank_trans <- extract_lower(reorder_mat(mat_cl_trans))

cross_cor <- cor(do.call(cbind, mat_list), method = "spearman")

cf_cross <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166ac", "white", "#d73027"))
ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  cross_cor,
  col                 = cf_cross,
  name                = "Spearman r",
  cluster_rows        = TRUE,
  cluster_columns     = TRUE,
  row_names_gp        = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_gp     = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_names_rot    = 45,
  column_title        = "Cross-matrix Spearman correlation (lower-triangle entries)",
  column_title_gp     = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid::grid.text(round(cross_cor[i, j], 2), x, y,
                    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
)
```

mats_table <- list(
  "Expression correlation" = reorder_mat(mat_expr_full),
  "PAGA connectivity"      = reorder_mat(mat_paga_full),
  "PCA distance"           = reorder_mat(mat_pca_full),
  "Graph distance"         = reorder_mat(mat_graph_full)
)
if (!is.null(mat_scenic_full))
  mats_table[["SCENIC correlation"]] <- reorder_mat(mat_scenic_full)

for (nm in names(mats_table)) {
  cat("\n\n###", nm, "\n\n")
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    DT::datatable(as.data.frame(round(mats_table[[nm]], 3)),
                  rownames = TRUE, filter = "none", caption = nm,
                  options = list(pageLength = n_cl, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "t"))
  ))
}
